style-thief-matching-modes.label: INTERACTIVE PROOF / MATCHING METHODS
style-thief-matching-modes.title: Ten methods. One image pair.
style-thief-matching-modes.description: Choose a method to see its result. Use Source and Target to check the original images.
style-thief-matching-modes.credit: Source and target: Style Thief test set.

states.label: Source
states.alt: Original pale and rust-coloured cobblestone source texture before Style Thief matching
states.caption: The source texture supplies the structure and surface detail.

states.label: Target
states.alt: Moss-covered cobblestone target reference used by Style Thief
states.caption: The target reference supplies the overall colour direction.

states.label: MK Ultra
states.alt: Cobblestone source matched to the moss reference with Style Thief MK Ultra
states.caption: A balanced, general-purpose colour transfer.

states.label: Compound A
states.alt: Cobblestone source matched to the moss reference with Style Thief Compound A
states.caption: A stronger compound interpretation of the target palette.

states.label: Compound B
states.alt: Cobblestone source matched to the moss reference with Style Thief Compound B
states.caption: An alternative compound match with a different colour balance.

states.label: Raging Heart
states.alt: Cobblestone source matched to the moss reference with Style Thief Raging Heart
states.caption: A warmer global shift based on the colour relationships in the reference.

states.label: Spectrum
states.alt: Cobblestone source matched to the moss reference with Style Thief Spectrum
states.caption: A smooth histogram-led remap of colour and tone.

states.label: MV Gaussian
states.alt: Cobblestone source matched to the moss reference with Style Thief MV Gaussian
states.caption: A broad multivariate interpretation of the target palette.

states.label: Lab Shift
states.alt: Cobblestone source matched to the moss reference with Style Thief Lab Shift
states.caption: A direct, controlled palette shift in Lab colour space.

states.label: Crosscut
states.alt: Cobblestone source matched to the moss reference with Style Thief Crosscut
states.caption: A distinct distribution-based interpretation.

states.label: Matrix
states.alt: Cobblestone source matched to the moss reference with Style Thief Matrix
states.caption: A bold global palette transfer.

states.label: Raw
states.alt: Cobblestone source matched to the moss reference with Style Thief PCCM Raw
states.caption: The original high-variance PCCM interpretation.

states.label: Aligned
states.alt: Cobblestone source matched to the moss reference with Style Thief PCCM Aligned
states.caption: A more stable PCCM interpretation with aligned light and dark direction.
